title: Tape 1: Logs hidden from core game files
claim: Tape Girl says she hid her logs in a protected room away from the core gameplay files, where only a beta tester would look, and that the game contains malicious code her team could not contain or understand.
quote: This game has some kind of malicious code in it that we haven't been able to fully contain...or even understand for that matter. We're over budget and out of time. …
location: Tape Girl log #1 (hidden cassette collectible; played in the Tape Room)

when.label: During the Virtual Experience's development (undated)
when.basis: Help Wanted gives no in-universe year; the tapes describe the first studio's development period

title: Tape 2: First sighting of the character

quote: It was like it was actually looking in the window seeing what I was doing.
